Messages.Author: John M. Baker
Messages.Body:
I normally can't Compel the Soul on a Mummy because the Mummy is shuffled
back into my library
when he is burned.

However, if I had discarded Akhenaten on an earlier turn, then could I
Compel that Akhenaten back
into play if the copy of Akhenaten that was in play recently burned (and was
shuffled back into my
library)?

John Baker

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <75o8kf$1e...@r02n01.cac.psu.edu>,

"John M. Baker" <fau...@psu.edu> wrote:
> I normally can't Compel the Soul on a Mummy because the Mummy is shuffled
> back into my library
> when he is burned.

"Compel the Spirit", right.

> However, if I had discarded Akhenaten on an earlier turn, then could I
> Compel that Akhenaten back
> into play if the copy of Akhenaten that was in play recently burned (and was
> shuffled back into my
> library)?

No. It says "Move the card from your ash heap" not "move any card of the same
name from your ash heap".

Similarly, if you had discarded a Raven Spy and had a second Raven Spy burned
since your last turn, you could only use Compel the Spirit to bring back
the second one (and could not use a second Compel the Spirit to bring back
the first).
